rule:
The width of a tread must not be less than the minimum required for this type of building.

Regulatory text (the authoritative clauses - use them to interpret the requirement and its applicability; you must still work out how to read or measure it from the IFC):
BCA Approved Document (Acceptable Solutions) V7.08 - applicability:
E.2.1 A staircase (including a flight of 2 steps or more) shall provide a safe and suitable passage for movement of people.
E.2.2 A staircase must have - ... (b) landings to break a fall and provide a place for rest; (c) sufficient width, tread and riser to avoid injury; ...
E.2.4 The requirements in paragraph E.2.2(b) and (c) do not apply to a staircase located in any of the following rooms or spaces:
  (a) any equipment or plant room;
  (b) any production area of an industrial building;
  (c) any attic that - (ii) does not exceed an area of 10 square metres; and (iii) is in a residential building;
  (d) any house built for the owner's own use.
E.3.4 Risers and treads:
E.3.4.2 The width of a tread of a staircase (see Figure E.3.4.2(a) for measurement of “tread”) shall not be less than:
  a) 225 mm, if the staircase is in a residential unit within a residential building;
  b) 250 mm, if the staircase is in an industrial building; or
  c) 275 mm, if the staircase is in any other type of building, including common staircases in a residential building.
E.3.4.3 The width of the tread of any tapered step shall be measured at a distance of 500 mm from the narrower end.

This model is a building that is neither industrial nor residential. Label every stair flight: it fails when any of its treads is narrower than the minimum. Label a flight NA when its staircase is exempt under E.2.1 or E.2.4, or when the flight has only one riser, so that no tread lies between its risers; a flight with two or more risers has at least one tread and is assessed. A flight whose tread width cannot be determined cannot be judged: label it ALERT, and do NOT report it as a violation.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcStairFlight) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
notes: E.3.4.2/E.3.4.3 measured on every tread, with E.2.1/E.2.4 applicability: {'FAIL': 36, 'NA': 2, 'PASS': 40}. Supersedes tread_width_e342__mall_deprecated_v1.

reference.status: Geometric tread depths (rectangular treads: short side; tapered treads: 500 mm from the narrow end) corroborated by recorded tread values; outcome conflicts stop generation. Not expert certification.
reference.policy: Minimum 275 mm for a building that is neither industrial nor residential. A flight fails if any tread is narrower. Single-step staircases (E.2.1) are NA.
reference.limitations: Tread faces are read from the exported flight meshes; the arrival edge is excluded when it is deeper than the treads.
